hook: Why are global diesel supplies projected to remain constrained well into 2027?

sections.voiceover: Why are global diesel supplies projected to remain constrained well into 2027?
b_roll: tanker ships in the Persian Gulf

sections.voiceover: Middle East conflicts disrupted fuel exports from Iran. Why did global diesel exports fall by 700,000 barrels as Middle East shipments struggled?
b_roll: refinery map of Europe and Middle East

sections.voiceover: Yet replenishing lost diesel inventories may not begin before the second half of 2027.
The International Energy Agency reported tight markets and high prices persist through 2027. World oil demand projects a recovery of 2.6 mb/d in 2027.
b_roll: IEA report documents and price charts

sections.voiceover: Tight diesel markets and constrained supplies will definitely persist throughout 2027.
